summary: This document proposes a SIP header, Session-ID, that carries a globally unique identifier for a session, kept consistent across proxies, back-to-back user agents and other middleboxes, to help troubleshooting. It documents a mechanism that was already widely deployed. It was replaced by RFC 7989.

eli5.summary: When a phone call passes through many switchboards, it helps if every operator writes the same ticket number on it. This RFC adds one shared number so problems can be traced. It was later replaced.

questions: how to trace a sip call across proxies
